summary: Initialized the opted-in append-only evidence ledger before functional track work.
Track 01 completion receipt and merged hosted checks satisfy the hard-start dependency; reversible schema and fixture work is admitted.

Restricted SourceRight to executable read-only commands, made malformed relationships diagnostic-safe, and made redaction custody explicit.

PR 41 required workflows passed and merged, but Codecov patch coverage was 85.20 percent against 90 percent; focused tests raised evidence-module coverage to 99.06 percent for hosted revalidation.

Fresh review found that the append-only ledger never reconciled PR 42's successful hosted checks and merge, while workflow history continuity and malformed failure boundaries lacked direct enforcement. Issue 7 was reopened pending remediation and revalidation.

PR 42 passed Agent Skill Conformance, dependency review, Linux, macOS and Windows quality jobs, Vale, and Codecov patch coverage before merge as 8405609; issue 7 closed afterward, resolving the previously unrecorded hosted gap.

Fresh review now rejects discontinuous event histories, diagnoses malformed audit receipt entries, and fails closed on invalid SourceRight timeouts or execution errors.
